description: This file defines the 'Code' class, representing a domain entity for codes within the Fineract infrastructure. It includes properties like name, systemDefined flag, and associated CodeValues, along with methods for creation, updating, and removal.

classes.name: Code
classes.description: Entity class representing a code with a name, system-defined flag, and associated values, including methods for creation, updating, and removal.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Code instance from a JsonCommand input.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new Code instance with the specified name.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Code's name if changed, throws exception if code is system-defined.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified CodeValue from the Code's set of values.
